title: Slimmer Threejs Viewport Gizmo
description: Make semio ui SceneGizmo (drei GizmoViewport) thinner and cleaner: reduce axis scale, head scale, margins; avoid chunky cube appearance.
summary: Fixed chunky GizmoViewport: axisScale was [1.35,1.35,1.35] which replaces drei's [length,thickness,thickness] default with a fat cube. Set [0.88,0.036,0.036], axisHeadScale 0.92, hideNegativeAxes, margin 80, font 16px in semio/ui SceneGizmo and elements/ui Gizmo. semio/ui vitest 230 passed; elements/ui 25 passed.
